payout.title: Wave payout account (LawPay)
payout.description: Your customers pay with Wave, and your share of each sale is paid out to this Wave number immediately, minus fees and commission. Without an active Wave account, your products cannot be ordered.
payout.ownerOnly: Only the business owner can manage the payout account.
payout.notConfigured: No Wave account is set up yet: your products cannot be ordered. Enter your Wave number below, then confirm with this card's button — the “Save changes” button at the bottom of the page does not save this field.
payout.saved: Wave number saved. Your customers can now order.
payout.numberHint: The number must be linked to a Wave account: it is the one that will receive your money. Every change is logged.
payout.saveError: Unable to save the payout account.

online.title: Payout account
online.description: Your customers pay online (Wave, Orange Money, card…). Your share of each sale is paid to this mobile money account once the order is delivered and approved by Diarama, minus the commission.
online.notConfigured: No payout account is set up yet: enter the operator and the number below, then confirm with this card's button.
online.numberHint: The number must belong to an account with the chosen operator: it is the one that receives your money. Every change is logged.

geolocation.label: Headquarters geolocation (optional)
geolocation.help: Save your device's position, place the point on the map, or enter the coordinates by hand.
geolocation.unavailable: Geolocation is not available on this device.
geolocation.denied: Access to the position was denied. Pick the point on the map or enter the coordinates.
geolocation.failed: Unable to get the device's position.
geolocation.mapHint: Click on the map or drag the marker to adjust the position.
